name: Twitcharr
description: A polished Twitch Live TV lineup for Dispatcharr. Add channels or discovery rules, then sync channels, streams and XMLTV guide data using anonymous Twitch metadata only. No OAuth, Client ID, Client Secret or Twitch sign-in required.
author: eliasbruno124

fields.label: Twitch channels and discovery
fields.placeholder:
gronkh, papaplatte(family), knossi
top:de:25
game:Just Chatting:10
search:knossi
fields.description: Enter Twitch names or URLs, separated by commas or line breaks. Discovery rules are supported: top, top:<lang>:<n>, game:<category>:<n>, search:<text>:<n>. Append (profile1, profile2) to any entry to add its channels to specific Dispatcharr channel profiles.

fields.label: Channel profiles
fields.description: Optional comma-separated Dispatcharr channel profile names. Every Twitcharr-managed channel is added to these profiles on sync. Use * for all profiles. Per-channel overrides: name(profile1, profile2) in the channels field.

fields.label: Channel group
fields.description: Channel group used for all Twitcharr-managed channels in Dispatcharr.

fields.label: Channel name prefix
fields.description: Optional text added before every Twitch channel name. Spaces are preserved.

fields.label: Channel name suffix
fields.description: Optional text added after every Twitch channel name. Spaces are preserved.

fields.label: Per-channel name templates
fields.description: Optional per-channel templates that replace the global prefix/suffix for that login. Use one 'login = template' entry per line and include {name} where the Twitch display name should appear.

fields.label: Starting channel number
fields.description: First channel number used for new Twitcharr channels. Existing Twitcharr channel numbers are kept stable when possible.

fields.label: Maximum quality
fields.description: Automatic measures your internet connection once a day and picks the best quality it can carry, 60 fps included. A fixed maximum helps when a device on weak Wi-Fi stutters. Streams without that exact quality fall back to the next lower one.

fields.label: Show offline channels
fields.description: Keep offline streamers in the lineup for a stable Emby/Jellyfin channel list. When disabled, offline channels are removed and recreated when they go live.

fields.label: Live indicator
fields.description: Controls whether live programmes use the XMLTV <live /> element, the red dot title prefix, both, or neither.

fields.label: Channel logo
fields.description: Uses a stable Twitch avatar for the channel logo by default. Programme artwork is set separately below.

fields.label: Programme artwork
fields.description: Image shown for a live programme: the box art of the game or category being streamed, or a fresh preview frame of the stream, updated with every guide refresh.

fields.label: Ad blocker
fields.description: Plays through the ad-free ttv.lol proxies (server list fetched and tested automatically). If an ad comes through anyway, Twitcharr switches to a new session as an embedded Twitch player, for which Twitch plays far fewer ads. Ads that still come through are filtered out; the picture pauses briefly instead.

fields.label: Emby / Jellyfin URL
fields.description: Optional Emby or Jellyfin base URL. Twitcharr triggers Refresh Guide when the guide visibly changes, otherwise once every 20 hours, and keeps the channel logos there up to date.

fields.label: Emby / Jellyfin API key
fields.description: Required when an Emby or Jellyfin URL is set. This is your media-server API key, not a Twitch token.

actions.label: Sync now
actions.description: Runs the complete refresh flow: update ttv.lol if needed, refresh Twitch data, write the guide, sync channels and refresh the media server.

actions.label: Refresh guide
actions.description: Refreshes Twitch live status, writes XMLTV guide data and updates Dispatcharr EPG rows before refreshing clients.

actions.label: Sync channels
actions.description: Writes the current guide, creates or updates channels, links them to fresh EPG rows immediately and refreshes the media server.

actions.label: Full refresh
actions.description: Runs the ttv.lol check, refreshes Twitch metadata, writes the guide, syncs channels and refreshes the media server in one pass.

actions.label: Measure bandwidth
actions.description: Measures available bandwidth, saves the Mbps value and updates the adaptive Streamlink profile.

actions.label: Test proxies
actions.description: Tests each ttv.lol proxy server and reports reachability, HTTP status, latency and the order currently used.

actions.label: Refresh Emby / Jellyfin
actions.description: Triggers Refresh Guide on the configured Emby or Jellyfin server so channel and EPG changes appear there after sync.

actions.label: Update ttv.lol
actions.description: Checks GitHub for the newest stable ttv.lol release and installs it only after its published SHA-256 digest and Python syntax validate.

actions.label: Uninstall
actions.description: Removes the managed StreamProfile, OutputProfile, EPG source, channels, streams and unused Twitcharr logos, then refreshes Emby/Jellyfin once if configured.

confirm.title: Remove all managed objects?
confirm.message: Deletes the Twitch StreamProfile, OutputProfile, EPG source and every channel or stream created by Twitcharr. The plugin and its settings stay in place. Emby/Jellyfin Refresh Guide is triggered afterwards if configured.
